verdict.rationale: Riveter offers a scrape endpoint that turns a URL into parseable text, so a JS-rendering wait-for-selector option is a fair question for it. However, no evidence documents waiting on a CSS selector before returning a page. The 'wait' long-poll and wait_for_result only wait for an asynchronous run to finish, which is a different capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the API wait for a specific selector to appear before returning the rendered page
